businessPlan: Provide opt-in Serena-aware workflow catalog examples so projects can choose semantic navigation role variants without changing default Brain/Coder/Reviewer behavior or making Serena mandatory. The user-facing invariant is additive adoption: existing installations that keep the default workflow and disabled/absent semanticNavigation config must resolve the same tool lists, while projects that explicitly bind Serena variants get Brain/Reviewer readonly navigation and Coder navigation plus explicitly cataloged edit tools.
technicalPlan: Make the change in catalog/data/docs/tests only unless a failing smoke exposes a resolver regression. Add optional profile entries to examples/workflow.tool-profiles.json using the exact requested ids: brain-serena-readonly, coder-serena-and-edit, reviewer-serena-readonly. Preserve existing profile ids and tool arrays exactly. Add optional agent catalog entries in examples/workflow.agent-catalog.json that bind the Serena profiles to the existing premium model presets, prompt packs, and reviewer quality gates while leaving default agent ids unchanged. Keep Serena MCP tool names in JSON examples/catalog entries and documentation, not in runtime role logic. Add a TASK-002 smoke script that first proves current absence fails, then verifies default resolution, Serena variant resolution, reviewer readonly exclusion, coder edit opt-in, and override precedence.
parallelAssessment: Serial execution. The task has brain:parallel=auto, but the safe contracts are small and tightly coupled across the same JSON catalogs, docs, and one smoke script; splitting would create unnecessary coordination risk over shared profile ids/tool lists.
contractBlockPlan: Blocks: (1) Test block owns scripts/task-002-serena-tool-profiles-smokes.ts and encodes exact default profile baselines plus Serena variant assertions. (2) Tool-profile catalog block owns examples/workflow.tool-profiles.json and adds only the three optional Serena profiles. (3) Agent-catalog block owns examples/workflow.agent-catalog.json and adds only optional Serena agent entries that reference existing model/prompt/quality-gate catalogs. (4) Documentation block owns docs/workflow-config-v2.md and explains how to opt into these examples, fallback/evidence limits, and override precedence. Shared contract: readonly Serena tools are mcp__serena__activate_project, mcp__serena__get_symbols_overview, mcp__serena__find_symbol, mcp__serena__find_referencing_symbols, mcp__serena__search_for_pattern; edit tools allowed only in coder-serena-and-edit are mcp__serena__replace_symbol_body, mcp__serena__insert_before_symbol, and mcp__serena__insert_after_symbol. Reviewer profiles must never include the edit-tool list.
acceptanceCriteria: Default tool profiles remain unchanged when Serena is disabled/absent.
Serena profile examples include Brain readonly, Coder navigation plus configured edit tools, and Reviewer readonly.
Reviewer profile excludes Serena edit/refactor tools.
Coder includes Serena edit tools only when explicitly configured.
Override precedence for existing profile resolution remains intact.

acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.criterion: Default tool profiles remain unchanged when Serena is disabled/absent.
acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.businessRiskIfWrong: Existing users could unexpectedly receive Serena MCP tools or lose built-in tools just by upgrading, making an optional feature disruptive.

requiredEvidence.description: Smoke asserts the three default profile tool arrays and the default workflow's resolved role tools exactly match the pre-Serena baseline.
Existing TASK-001 semanticNavigation config smoke still passes after additive catalog changes.

blockingConditions: Any existing default profile id is removed or renamed.
Any existing default profile tool array changes.
The default examples/workflow.json role bindings select Serena agents by default.

acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.businessRiskIfWrong: Users would not have a copyable opt-in path for role-appropriate Serena adoption.
